title: QUIC RFC 9000 Connection Close Packet-Level Emission Work Item
summary: Implement and prove local CONNECTION_CLOSE emission across the packet protection levels required before and after handshake confirmation.
planned_changes:
- Add close-only Initial and Handshake protected packet builders.
- Teach the runtime to emit post-confirmation close in 1-RTT when 1-RTT protection is available.
- Teach the runtime to emit server Initial, Handshake, and 1-RTT close packets before confirmation when the corresponding protection material is available.
- Downgrade application close frames in Initial and Handshake packets to transport APPLICATION_ERROR with an empty reason phrase.
- Add focused requirement-home proof for the packet-level close matrix and update canonical trace artifacts.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, the focused S10P2P3 requirement-home filter, adjacent close/packet-space regression filters, regenerate QUIC coverage triage, and validate SpecTrace JSON.
out_of_scope: Coalescing close packets into one UDP datagram.
Changing peer close-frame parsing or close/drain timer behavior.
Removing the legacy bare close fallback for states without protected close material.
completion_notes: Completed as packet-level close emission and downgrade behavior. Coalescing and broader lifecycle cleanup remain separate follow-ons.
